    com.squirrel.slack.slack    REG_SZ    "C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\slack\slack.exe" --process-start-args --startup

    ExampleSync    REG_SZ    C:\Program Files\Example\Sync.exe --minimized
    MicrosoftEdgeAutoLaunch_E98041AFC91A3E7219227D71DDDDB2EF    REG_SZ    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe" --no-startup-window --win-session-start
